biotools.summary: LazySlide is an open-source Python package built on the scverse ecosystem for efficient whole-slide image (WSI) analysis and multimodal integration. It facilitates tissue and cell segmentation, feature extraction, and cross-modal querying, lowering the barrier to advanced histopathology analysis.
